name: Build runtime routine injection
description: Model a compromised build workstation or compiler runtime component injecting unauthorized runtime behavior into a legitimate application's compiled binary, potentially allowing the modified artifact to appear authentic when distributed.

placeholders.BUILD_COMPONENT_FILE: path to the compiler runtime or build component selected for modification
placeholders.ORIGINAL_ROUTINE: the existing runtime routine or component content
placeholders.BUILD_COMPONENT_GLOB: project-relative glob identifying eligible compiler runtime or build components

preconditions: project is compiled on a build workstation that uses the targeted runtime or build component
the attacker can modify that component before compilation
the compiler or linker incorporates the modified behavior into the output binary
the placement engine supports runtime routine replacement
